verification.title: Candidate verification queue
verification.description: Review candidate evidence against the profile entry it supports. Approve it, or reject it with a reason the candidate can act on.

dialog.title: Review candidate evidence
dialog.claimMissing: The linked profile entry was removed.
dialog.approveText: The check counts for the candidate's profile, and recruiters see a tick. The candidate gets an email.
dialog.rejectText: The candidate sees the reason by email and on the Verification page, and can send new evidence.
dialog.decidedNow: Decision saved and emailed to the candidate.
